children: NeoVolta entered into a $20 million secured term loan with Horizon Technology Finance and ROHO Capital Opportunity Fund, maturing Mar 3, 2028 at a 10.00% rate, with amortization beginning Dec 4, 2026 and a potential $10 million upsizing. The facility is secured by a first-priority lien and includes liquidity covenants and a Minimum Cushion Requirement. In connection with the financing, NeoVolta issued five-year warrants for 1,454,545 shares at a $3.30 exercise price, plus potential additional warrants, featuring ownership and issuance caps, cashless exercise, and anti-dilution protections. The company also granted registration rights to Horizon and ROHO and will file an S-3 to register warrant shares for resale.
